description: Rules for using design tokens in this design-repo. Category names are the real keys of tokens/llm/token-catalog.json `categories`; slot names are the real keys of the PageSpec `tokens` object (closed in schema/pagespec.schema.json). extraction/verify_all.py (token-policy check) resolves every category, slot, allowed path and theme scope against the catalog, and schema/semantic_validate.py enforces them on every PageSpec (TOKEN_* rules in compatibility/graph.json). Hand-authored; every allowed path is a real catalog token.

allowedUsage.referenceSyntax: A PageSpec names a token by its bare catalog path, e.g. semantic.surface.page, fontSize.h2, layout.sectionPadding.large. Token files reference each other by path ('ref', component tokens). Nothing else in a PageSpec can carry a colour, a length, a font or an easing.
allowedUsage.where: Only in the PageSpec `tokens` object (page-level slots below). Section-internal styling (button variants, card radii, per-section paddings, motion timing) is owned by the section/component contracts; a node carries no style or token override (the schema has no field for one, and the adversarial suite proves a smuggled `tokens` field on a node is rejected).
allowedUsage.motion: Motion is chosen per node through motion.pattern (closed enum = the motion.pattern.* catalog tokens) plus its reducedMotionFallback (motion.reducedMotionFallback.*). Durations and easings are optional and must be values measured for that pattern (MOTION_VALUES_MATCH_PATTERN).

rawValueRestrictions.$comment: Keys are catalog categories. Every category is forbidden as a raw value in a PageSpec: in token slots (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR / TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING / TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT / TOKEN_UNKNOWN) and, for colours and lengths, in any content string (TOKEN_RAW_COLOR / TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING).
rawValueRestrictions.color: forbidden: no hex (#rgb / #rrggbb / #rrggbbaa), rgb()/rgba(), hsl()/hsla() or CSS colour keyword; name a color.* or semantic.* token
rawValueRestrictions.semanticColor: forbidden: surfaces, text, accents, borders and icons are semantic.* tokens a theme resolves
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: forbidden: no family name or stack (Inter, Helvetica, 'Instrument Serif', serif ...); name fontFamily.sans or fontFamily.serif
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: forbidden: weights are fontWeight.* tokens and are owned by the contracts
rawValueRestrictions.typography: forbidden: no loose font-size / line-height (px, rem, em, pt, %); name a fontSize.* token
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: forbidden: no px / rem / em / vh / vw / % / calc() length; name a space.* or layout.* token
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: forbidden: breakpoints are breakpoint.* tokens owned by the contracts' responsive entries
rawValueRestrictions.layout: forbidden: container widths and section paddings are layout.* tokens
rawValueRestrictions.component: forbidden: component tokens are owned by the component contracts
rawValueRestrictions.motion: forbidden: no raw duration, delay or cubic-bezier(); patterns and fallbacks are motion.* tokens

forbiddenRawValuePatterns.$comment: The exact patterns schema/semantic_validate.py applies (pinned there as RAW_COLOR_RE / RAW_LENGTH_RE / FONT_NAME_RE as well).
forbiddenRawValuePatterns.color: #[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b | (rgb|rgba|hsl|hsla)\s*\( | the CSS colour keywords white, black, red, green, blue, yellow, transparent, currentColor (token slots only)
forbiddenRawValuePatterns.font: any value of a font slot that is not a fontFamily.* catalog path

pageSpecTokenSlots.$comment: The closed set of page-level token slots. `allow` lists the only catalog paths a slot accepts; `kind` is the catalog category the slot expects; themeResolved slots accept only semantic tokens the declared theme resolves; themeScope restricts a foundation colour to the themes whose pages really use it.

text.purpose: Body text colour; must reach minTextContrast against the surface slot in the declared theme.

accent.purpose: Accent (active chip, primary hover, the content theme's yellow brand, the mentoring brand button).

headingScale.purpose: Desktop size of the page's leading heading; the contracts step it down per breakpoint.

sectionPadding.purpose: Vertical rhythm of content sections; a token, never a measured length.

gap.purpose: Default gap between stacked blocks inside a section.

cardRadius.purpose: Corner radius of cards, panels and media.

themeRules.$comment: Allowed theme/token combinations. Pinned in schema/semantic_validate.py (PINNED_TOKEN_RULES) as well as here; verify_all compares the two.
themeRules.themeMustExist: spec.theme must be a theme of the catalog (tokens/themes/*.json) and must equal the template's theme (THEME_MATCHES_TEMPLATE).
themeRules.themeResolved: A themeResolved slot may only name a semantic token that the declared theme resolves (catalog themes.<theme>.semanticTokens).

color.brand-blue.evidence: src/components/shared/Button.jsx:16-16 (brand button, used on /mentoring, a nimbus-dark template)

themeRules.contrast: The text slot, resolved through the declared theme, must reach minTextContrast (WCAG 2.x relative-luminance ratio) against the surface slot.

fallbackRules.$comment: What a generator does when the token it wants is missing or not allowed.
fallbackRules.unknownToken: Never invent a path. Use the slot's first `allow` entry (the measured default) and keep the content.
fallbackRules.rawValueWanted: Never write the raw value. Pick the nearest allowed token of the same category; if none fits, leave the optional slot out (required slots always have an allowed default).
fallbackRules.fontUnavailable: Fonts are fontFamily.serif / fontFamily.sans only. The stacks already fall back (Georgia / Arial, then generic); never substitute another family in the PageSpec.
fallbackRules.themeMismatch: If a token is outside the declared theme (themeScope) use the theme-neutral semantic token of that slot (e.g. semantic.accent.chip instead of color.content-yellow on nimbus-dark).
fallbackRules.reducedMotion: Every node carries motion.reducedMotionFallback; the fallbacks are motion.reducedMotionFallback.* tokens.
fallbackRules.notApproved: A token in notGenerationApproved must not be used; take the slot default instead.

notGenerationApprovedReason.fontFamily.source-serif: Declared in tailwind.config.js:63 and loaded by index.html, but no src/ class applies it (grep font-source-serif in src/ finds nothing): it never renders, so a generator must not build on it. verify_all re-checks this against the source when present.

overrides: A PageSpec carries no per-instance style or token override: page-level choices go through the closed `tokens` slots above; everything inside a section stays owned by the section/component contracts.
